title: BKompV Anlage 2 – Liste der Biotoptypen und -werte (BfN biotope code space)
publisher: Bundesrepublik Deutschland – Bundeskompensationsverordnung (BGBl. I 2020, 1088; Anlage 2: 1100–1122); code space of the BfN Rote Liste der gefährdeten Biotoptypen Deutschlands (Finck et al. 2017)
version: BKompV vom 14. Mai 2020, zuletzt geändert durch Art. 4 des Gesetzes vom 22. Dezember 2025 (BGBl. 2025 I Nr. 351); Anlage 2 as published on gesetze-im-internet.de (read 2026-09-30); Rote Liste Biotoptypen, 3. Fassung 2017 (Kurzliste)
license_note: Codes, names and values are facts of a federal ordinance and of the BfN Red List. Neither prescribes map colours, so no colours are given.
note: value = Biotopwert 0–24; values = per age class J/M/A (junge / mittlere / alte Ausprägung; MA = mittlere bis alte) where the annex splits a type. Wertstufen: 0–4 sehr gering, 5–9 gering, 10–15 mittel, 16–18 hoch, 19–21 sehr hoch, 22–24 hervorragend; § 5 allows up to ± 3 points for above- or below-average condition. Code = Red List code + optional BKompV letter (a, b …) + .01/.02 + optional age suffix. Age suffixes are attached without a dot (41.03.03J), so the dotted fallback of such a code skips its base type: strip the suffix and read 'values'. Rows are machine-extracted (V*); four odd codes are flagged in their notes. Entries with evidence V and no value are Red List types (Kurzliste 2017) added so that Red List and intermediate codes resolve; red_list_de / regenerability give the national Red List status. Arable values by soil: see entry 33. Urban complexes (51.x, 53.01.x) are whole areas incl. their open spaces: map either the complex or its parts, not both.
